name: diff-review
description: Terminal diff reviewer for Claude Code sessions running in Rex

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --splitting --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --minify --outdir=dist --entry-names=diff-review --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --out-extension:.js=.mjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env bun' && chmod +x dist/diff-review.mjs
